# Image transfer fixtures

Synthetic single-frame solid-color images generated with FFmpeg. They contain no user material.

- `original.gif`: blue, 2 by 2 pixels.
- `original.avif`: red, 64 by 64 pixels, encoded with SVT-AV1.

Used to verify native decoding and byte-preserving import and complete folder backup. Regeneration is not required to run the tests.
